ambiguity_flags.note: Can be read as a specific storage artifact (snapshots table, layer2_truth.db, or raw observations store) rather than the full architectural Layer-2 encompassing deterministic ingestion, validation, and snapshot publication. This weakens the snapshot boundary semantics (Category A) by collapsing an architectural layer into a storage component name. The canonical set has zero precedent for this term. The claim_classification_map (c7, c5) independently flags this as an unverified semantic equivalence and a potential blocking condition.

Semantically adjacent to the discouraged LAYER_3 variant 'decision engine'. May imply active decision-making or execution capability, which CLAUDE.md Section 9 explicitly forbids ('No component may simulate or imply execution capability'). Also creates ambiguity with the decision vocabulary taxonomy (NO_TRADE, DecisionPacket, guard/state/trigger taxonomies) — 'decision_layer' could be misread as the layer that executes decisions rather than the planned downstream computational layer. Governance-sensitive under Category B (phase/readiness: Layer-3 is NOT YET BUILT) and Category D (decision vocabulary connotation). The claim_classification_map (c7, c2 notes) independently flags this execution connotation as a blocking risk.
